description: Outgoing dependency validation errors. A dependency must declare exactly one target: either a service name or a domain URL, never both and never neither. If neither or both are present the parse fails with a target-definition error. If a domain is declared with a scheme other than http or https the parse fails with an unsupported-protocol error that echoes the offending domain on its own field. Errors are reported as neutral category lines, not host-language exceptions.
